title: RustChap puzzle pack
description: Pack manifest: one track's metadata and its linear puzzle order. Lives at content/packs/<track>/pack.json with puzzles in puzzles/*.json next to it.

id.description: Track id; puzzle ids in this pack are '<id>.<nnn>'.

icon.description: Display-only: SF Symbol name for the deck tile. Clients may fall back when absent or unknown.

accent.description: Display-only: named accent color (orange, teal, indigo, ...). Clients map names to platform colors.

toolchain.description: Pinned Rust toolchain every puzzle in the pack is compiled against, e.g. '1.97.1'. Part of the outcomes cache key.

order.description: Linear progression. Empty = a planned deck, shown locked in the app ('solve all' can never hold for it, so nothing after it unlocks). The linter verifies each entry resolves to a puzzle file and prerequisites only point backwards.
